tests.title: Purchase order status and search filters match records
tests.goal: Purchase order status tabs and search fields return matching purchase orders.
preconditions: At least one purchase order exists in staging.
data: Existing PO/Lot number and product name or SKU, selected dynamically.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Inventory > Purchase Orders.
Select Processing, Partial Received, Received, and Canceled in turn.
Search for an existing PO/Lot number, then separately search by a product name or SKU.

expected.text: Rows in each status view show the selected status.
An exact PO/Lot search returns the matching record.
A product search returns only purchase orders containing the selected product.
